_doc: Settings of bench/perfgate.sh. There are no recorded numbers here: every run measures its reference build beside the candidate, on the same box, in the same run. limits and noise apply to the per-round ratio B / A; a metric whose rounds disagree across its limit by more than its noise bound is NOISY, and the answer is to run it again.

instr_by_callgrind._doc: instructions of these throughput angles are judged by the named callgrind angle: identical code moves them ±2–3% round to round

lx64._note: cpu n and n+8 share a physical core: the server gets 0-3, their siblings 8-11 stay empty, the load gets both threads of 4-7

firefly._note: RK3588: 0-3 are Cortex-A55, 4-7 Cortex-A76; the server gets the two fastest A76 cores, the load the rest
